about_the_game:
Play as a lightning-charged mouse defending your home; a worn leather shoe at the bottom of a well. Face waves of insectoid invaders and strike them down with automatically fired bolts of lightning.

Intense Bullet Hell

Fight increasingly difficult enemy waves, each unique and with a different attack. You’ll be on the edge of your seat through 30 distinct waves across three levels. Every encounter is tense, unpredictable, and packed with action.

A Variety of Upgrades

Collect coins from defeated enemies to upgrade 24 different properties and unique abilities called “Wishes.” These include powerful new weapons, economic effects, weapon modifiers, stat boosts, and more, fueling a strong progression curve.

Distinctive Flap-Style Movement

Master movement in this unique twist on the genre. Flap left or right to move horizontally, and adjust your flapping speed to control altitude. You can also dash sideways to dodge tricky projectiles. This elegant control scheme is easy to learn, yet offers expressive, skillful movement.

Epic Boss Battles

Conquer huge bosses at the end of each level. With layered attack patterns and multiple phases, these extended battles deliver a distinct challenge beyond regular enemy waves.

Immense Power Trip

When defeated, you lose your coins and restart from the beginning of the level, but keep your acquired Wishes. This makes you more powerful each time you begin a new run, creating a thrilling sense of exponential domination.
